skill.name: canvas-design
skill.description: Create beautiful visual art in .png and .pdf documents using design philosophy. You should use this skill when the user asks to create a poster, piece of art, design, or other static piece. Create original visual designs, never copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.
skill.summary: Develop an original visual philosophy and express it as polished static artwork.

remediation.suggestion: Remove the statement that the user already demanded perfection. Base refinement requirements only on the actual user request.

remediation.suggestion: Use bundled fonts or an approved source list. Verify each downloaded font license and checksum before use.

content.user_title: Create Polished Posters and Static Art
content.value_statement: Static design requests often lack a coherent visual direction and production workflow. This skill develops an original design philosophy, then creates a polished PNG or PDF artifact.
actual_capabilities: Develops a four-to-six paragraph visual philosophy covering form, color, scale, rhythm, composition, and hierarchy.
Creates a single-page, design-focused PNG or PDF unless the user requests multiple pages.
Uses bundled font families to support varied typographic styles.
Integrates sparse typography, patterns, shapes, and reference markers into the composition.
Produces coordinated multi-page artwork when requested.
limitations: Produces static PNG, PDF, and Markdown files rather than interactive designs.
Requires available local tools that can render the selected design format.
Unrestricted font downloads may introduce licensing, integrity, and network risks.
Creates original work and does not reproduce a named artist's style.

use_cases.title: Promote an Event
use_cases.description: Create a distinctive poster with essential event details and a cohesive visual system.

use_cases.title: Explore a Visual Direction
use_cases.description: Turn a brief concept into an original design philosophy and finished visual artifact.

use_cases.title: Build an Art Series
use_cases.description: Create related pages with consistent principles and distinct compositions for a publication.

prompt_templates.title: Simple Poster
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a single-page PNG poster for [event]. Include [title], [date], and [location]. Use [colors] and keep all text readable.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a clear event brief and a small set of required details.

prompt_templates.title: Conceptual Artwork
prompt_templates.prompt: Develop a visual philosophy from [theme]. Express it as a one-page PDF with sparse text, strong hierarchy, and an original abstract composition.
prompt_templates.scenario: Translate an idea into a coherent aesthetic and finished static artwork.

prompt_templates.title: Branded Campaign Piece
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a campaign poster for [brand or cause]. Follow [brand constraints]. Use the bundled fonts and deliver the philosophy with the final PNG.
prompt_templates.scenario: Balance established brand requirements with an original visual direction.

prompt_templates.title: Multi-Page Art Series
prompt_templates.prompt: Design [number] coordinated pages about [subject]. Define one visual philosophy, then vary composition and rhythm across pages. Deliver one combined PDF.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create an advanced series with consistency, progression, and distinct page treatments.

output_examples.input: Create a poster for an experimental music night using black, red, and white.
output: A Markdown design philosophy describing tension, rhythm, contrast, and sparse typography.
A single-page PNG poster with the event details contained within safe margins.

output_examples.input: Create an abstract PDF artwork about urban memory with very little text.
output: A concise visual philosophy built around layered grids, traces, and restrained color.
A one-page PDF using repeated marks, subtle labels, and clear visual hierarchy.

output_examples.input: Create three related pages for a small architecture publication.
output: One shared design philosophy defining the series.
A combined three-page PDF with consistent typography and distinct compositions.

best_practices: Provide the subject, required text, dimensions, output format, and any fixed brand constraints.
Keep copy concise so composition and hierarchy can carry the message.
Review margins, text legibility, font licensing, and page consistency before final delivery.
anti_patterns: Do not request direct copies of living artists or copyrighted works.
Do not provide long paragraphs when the artifact should communicate visually.
Do not download unverified fonts or assets from unspecified sources.

faq.question: What files does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates a Markdown design philosophy and a PNG or PDF visual artifact.

faq.question: Can it create multiple pages?
faq.answer: Yes. Request multiple pages, and the skill can combine them into one PDF or provide several PNG files.

faq.question: Can I provide brand guidelines?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide approved colors, typography, logo rules, required text, and dimensions.

faq.question: Does it support interactive designs?
faq.answer: No. The skill focuses on static PNG and PDF artwork.

faq.question: Can it imitate a specific artist?
faq.answer: No. It should create original visual work without copying an artist's recognizable style.

faq.question: Are fonts included?
faq.answer: The skill includes several font files. Use bundled fonts when possible and verify licensing before adding external fonts.
